profile_text.body:
OneTrust is an Atlanta, Georgia-based company founded in 2016 that, according to its website, helps organizations manage privacy, consent, and AI governance while automating compliance and reducing risk. The company describes its offering as connecting privacy, data, AI, and technology risk in one continuous system, with capabilities that include defining purpose, automating assessments, enforcing controls, and monitoring risks across domains. Its site presents the platform as providing a continuous, real-time view of how data and AI are used.

OneTrust's primary AI product is OneTrust AI Governance, categorized as an AI Governance and Risk Management Platform. The site markets it under the name the OneTrust AI-Ready Governance Platform, positioning it as a tool for embedding governance into data and AI workflows. The held facts note that the product takes a privacy-first approach with strengths in data governance and compliance automation, making it particularly suited to organizations where privacy is the primary concern.

The held facts associate OneTrust with 60 legal matters filed in Georgia, though no specific case details are recorded in the available data. The company has no MCP server presence or SEC filings noted in the held facts.
